recent.text: Darko isn’t sure if the Walter closeout on Brunson should’ve been a flagrant, “but it was a foul for sure.” Darko: “We had a breakdown on the defensive end. We did not cover that the way we wanted & he got an open shot. It was the right call.” Ja’Kobe called it a miscommunication

recent.text: Rajakovic says that starting Murray-Boyles and bringing Poeltl off the bench was more of a matchup thing vs the Knicks/Towns these past 2 games. Doesn’t sound like that’s the long-term plan, but we’ll see.

recent.text: The last time the Raptors beat New York (Jan. 22, 2023), RJ Barrett scored a game-high 30 points… for the Knicks. He and Quickley still haven’t defeated their former team. Anunoby hasn’t lost to his. The Knicks have now won 15 straight meetings.

recent.text: Ja'Kobe's had a fantastic game... but fouling a jump shooter in a tie game with 90 seconds left... the small details, man! Brunson knocks down the 3 and Walter gets hit with a fragrant. 4-point play, Knicks ball. Rough rough sequence.

recent.text: Career-best 7 made 3s for Walter now. He's 7-for-10 with 23 points (4 away from his career-high) in 24 minutes. Still 3 minutes left in the 3rd quarter.
